+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 MistVVK and the XeStrata contributors
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later
+"""Narrow cache512 receipt/owner primitives; no work until Main calls functions."""
+import fcntl
+import hashlib
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import math
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+import resource
+import sys
+import time
+
+B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
+P = B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-cache512-controller-source-v1'
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+OWNER = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
+OWNER_SHA = 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
+PCI = '0000:05:00.0'
+ENV = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8',
+           XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/run/user/' + str(os.getuid()),
+           DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS='unix:path=/run/user/' + str(os.getuid()) + '/bus')
+
+
+def need(value, message):
+    if not value:
+        raise ValueError(message)
+
+
+def sha(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    need(path.resolve() != (B / 'prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1/record.json').resolve(), 'credential receipt excluded')
+    need(path.is_file() and path.stat().st_size <= 512 << 20, 'bounded identity')
+    with path.open('rb') as stream:
+        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()
+
+
+def unique(pairs):
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        need(key not in result, 'duplicate JSON key')
+        result[key] = value
+    return result
+
+
+def load(path):
+    path = Path(path)
+    need(path.resolve() != (B / 'prefill-gemm-only-contract-root-v1/record.json').resolve(), 'credential receipt excluded before read')
+    need(path.is_absolute() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(B) and 0 < path.stat().st_size <= 16 << 20, 'bounded private JSON')
+    return json.loads(path.read_text(), object_pairs_hook=unique,
+                      parse_constant=lambda v: (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(v)))
+
+
+def pin(path):
+    return dict(path=str(Path(path).resolve()), sha256=sha(path))
+
+
+def exact(item):
+    need(type(item) is dict and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', item.get('sha256', '')), 'resolved exact pin')
+    path = Path(item['path'])
+    need(sha(path) == item['sha256'], 'immutable input')
+    if 'stat' in item:
+        v = path.stat()
+        actual = dict(device=v.st_dev, inode=v.st_ino, bytes=v.st_size, mtime_ns=v.st_mtime_ns, ctime_ns=v.st_ctime_ns)
+        need(actual == item['stat'], 'immutable stat identity')
+    return path
+
+
+def closed(record):
+    need(record.get('passed') is True and record.get('complete') is True and record.get('active') is False and
+         not record.get('error') and not record.get('kernel_gate_error'), 'actual completed PASS')
+    commands = record.get('commands', []) + record.get('guard_commands', [])
+    need(commands and all(strong(c) and c.get('exit_code') == 0 for c in commands), 'normal command receipts')
+    return record
+
+
+def strong(c):
+    return bool(c.get('observation_complete') and c.get('direct_child_reaped') and c.get('session_empty') and
+                c.get('session_anchored') and c.get('ownership_status') == 'observed' and not c.get('cleanup') and
+                not c.get('survivors') and not c.get('error') and not c.get('errors'))
+
+
+def packet():
+    frozen = load(HERE / 'source-pins.json')
+    need({x.name for x in P.glob('*.py')} == set(frozen['packet_python']), 'seven-file closure')
+    for name, digest in frozen['packet_python'].items():
+        need(sha(P / name) == digest, 'exact cache512 code before import')
+    need(sha(P / 'health_caps.cpp') == frozen['health_caps_sha256'], 'byte-identical CAPS source')
+    sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(P))
+    import common
+    import policy
+    return common, policy, frozen['packet_python']
+
+
+def cpu_cap(requested):
+    hard = resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU)[1]
+    cap = requested if hard == resource.RLIM_INFINITY else min(requested, hard - 1)
+    need(type(cap) is int and cap > 0, 'child CPU hard limit never exceeds parent')
+    return cap
+
+
+class CacheRun:
+    """Only these finite offline/compile/property cache512 steps; never a model launcher."""
+    def __init__(self, output, wall, gpu=False):
+        self.lock = (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a')
+        fcntl.flock(self.lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
+        need(output.is_absolute() and output.resolve().is_relative_to(B) and not output.exists() and
+             not any(output.resolve().is_relative_to(root) for root in
+                     (P, HERE, B / 'latest-update-pristine-official-long-controller-source-v1')), 'NEW separate private root')
+        need(sha(OWNER) == OWNER_SHA, 'owner exact before import')
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('cache512_owner', OWNER)
+        self.m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(self.m)
+        output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
+        self.output, self.wall, self.started = output, wall, time.monotonic()
+        self.r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, main_reviewed=True, commands=[],
+                      model_executed=False, model_launch_attempted=False, gpu_executed=gpu,
+                      started_utc=self.m.utc(), boot_id=Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip(),
+                      whole_wall_seconds=wall, owner_sha256=OWNER_SHA,
+                      helper_source_pins={x.name: sha(x) for x in HERE.glob('*.py')})
+        self.owner = self.m.Owner(output / 'commands', self.save)
+        self.r['commands'] = self.owner.commands
+        self.save()
+
+    def save(self):
+        (self.output / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.r, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+    def run(self, label, argv, env=ENV, cwd=P, wall=30, cpu=60, rss=4 << 30):
+        remaining = self.wall - (time.monotonic() - self.started)
+        need(remaining > 0, 'whole-step deadline')
+        c, so, se = self.owner.run(label, argv, env, cwd, wall=min(wall, remaining), cpu=cpu_cap(cpu),
+            rss_cap=rss, text_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, total_cap=96 << 20)
+        self.r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(
+            stdout=pin(so), stderr=pin(se), stdout_excerpt=so.read_text()[:8192], stderr_excerpt=se.read_text()[:8192])
+        self.save()
+        need(strong(c) and c.get('exit_code') == 0, 'normal anchored closure ' + label)
+        return so.read_text(), se.read_text()
+
+    def finish(self, error=None):
+        if error is not None:
+            self.r['error'] = repr(error)
+        self.r.update(active=self.owner.active is not None, finished_utc=self.m.utc(),
+                      boot_unchanged=self.r['boot_id'] == Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip())
+        self.r['passed'] = bool(self.r['complete'] and not self.r['active'] and self.r['boot_unchanged'] and
+                                not self.r.get('error') and not self.r.get('kernel_gate_error') and
+                                all(sha(HERE / name) == digest for name, digest in self.r['helper_source_pins'].items()) and
+                                all(strong(c) and c.get('exit_code') == 0 for c in self.r['commands']))
+        self.save()
+        self.lock.close()
+        return 0 if self.r['passed'] else 1
+
+
+BOOLS = ('root_device', 'usm_device_allocations', 'usm_host_allocations', 'usm_atomic_host_allocations',
+         'usm_shared_allocations', 'usm_atomic_shared_allocations', 'usm_system_allocations')
+NUMBERS = ('ze_status', 'ze_properties_status', 'sycl_properties_status', 'ze_max_mem_alloc_size',
+           'sycl_max_mem_alloc_size', 'sycl_global_mem_size', 'allocation_attempts', 'kernel_attempts',
+           'context_attempts', 'queue_attempts', 'copy_attempts')
+
+
+def caps(text):
+    need(len(text.encode()) <= 2049 and text.endswith('\n') and text.count('\n') == 1, 'one bounded CAPS line')
+    fields = text[:-1].split(' ')
+    need(fields[0] == 'CAPS' and all(x.count('=') == 1 for x in fields[1:]), 'CAPS fields')
+    result = unique([x.split('=', 1) for x in fields[1:]])
+    need(set(result) == set(BOOLS + NUMBERS) | {'pci_bdf', 'backend', 'vendor_id', 'native_device_id', 'relaxed_limits'}, 'exact known CAPS keys')
+    need(result['pci_bdf'] == PCI and result['backend'] == 'level_zero' and result['vendor_id'] == '0x8086' and
+         result['native_device_id'] == '0xe20c' and result['relaxed_limits'] == 'unset', 'independently fixed native identity/normal limits')
+    for key in BOOLS:
+        need(result[key] in ('0', '1'), 'strict boolean aspect')
+        result[key] = result[key] == '1'
+    for key in NUMBERS:
+        need(re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]{0,19}', result[key]), 'canonical uint64')
+        result[key] = int(result[key])
+        need(result[key] <= (1 << 64) - 1, 'uint64 range')
+    result.update(vendor_id=0x8086, native_device_id=0xe20c, expected_native_device_id=0xe20c,
+                  single_block_request_bytes=1276953600)
+    need(result['root_device'] and result['usm_device_allocations'] and result['sycl_global_mem_size'] > 0,
+         'root/device-USM/global properties')
+    need(all(result[x] == 0 for x in NUMBERS if x.endswith('_status') or x.endswith('_attempts')), 'successful property-only zero-work')
+    need(result['ze_max_mem_alloc_size'] >= 1276953600 and result['sycl_max_mem_alloc_size'] >= 1276953600, 'dual allocation threshold')
+    return result

+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('--main-reviewed', action='store_true', required=True)
+    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    _, _, pins = packet()
+    run = CacheRun(args.output, 120)
+    run.r['controller_source_pins'] = pins
+    error = None
+    try:
+        text, _ = run.run('parser-owned-mock-pending', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B',
+            str(P / 'controller_cpu_fixtures.py'), '--owned-mock-output', str(args.output / 'mock'),
+            '--invalid-pending-output', str(args.output / 'invalid-pending')], wall=60, cpu=60)
+        result = json.loads(text)
+        keys = ('parser_malformed_fixtures_passed', 'owned_mock_quit_passed',
+                'invalid_admission_prelaunch_passed', 'invalid_pending_process_passed')
+        need(all(result.get(key) is True for key in keys), 'actual parser/mock/pre-owner pending child')
+        for commands in (result['commands'], result['invalid_pending_commands']):
+            closed(dict(passed=True, complete=True, active=False, commands=commands))
+        run.r.update({key: result[key] for key in keys})
+        run.r['fixture_result'] = result
+        text, _ = run.run('CAPS-pure-fixtures', ['/usr/bin/python3', '-B', str(HERE / 'caps_fixtures.py')],
+                          cwd=HERE, wall=30, cpu=30)
+        run.r['caps_parser_fixtures'] = json.loads(text)
+        need(run.r['caps_parser_fixtures']['passed'] is True, 'pure CAPS parser')
+        need(all(sha(P / name) == digest for name, digest in pins.items()), 'exact unchanged seven sources')

+    except BaseException as caught:
+        error = caught
+    code = run.finish(error)
+    print(json.dumps(dict(passed=run.r['passed'], error=run.r.get('error'))))
+    return code
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    raise SystemExit(main())
